identification: AWA (Amalgamated Wireless Australasia) Radiola model 510M, 5-valve broadcast and shortwave bakelite mantel radio, 1946-47 (radiomuseum.org: AWA Radiola 510M, 5 valves, BC+SW, bakelite, 12.5 x 8 x 7.5 in). Brown bakelite, horizontal-rib grille with cloth, dual-wave dial with Australian station call signs, three knobs. Maker not named on cabinet but chassis stamp reads MODEL 510M (serial about 00053711) with green AWA-style label.
